description: The line plot titled "Search Space of M-Cube" illustrates the number of possible solutions in relation to the number of missing pieces in a cube. The x-axis is labeled "# Missing pieces" and is a linear scale ranging from 1 to 6. The y-axis is labeled "# Possible solutions" and is a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^0 to 10^8. There are two lines in the plot: one representing "Flip needed" and the other "Flip ignored." The "Flip needed" line is colored orange and has a solid line style, while the "Flip ignored" line is colored blue and also has a solid line style. Both lines show an exponential increase in the number of possible solutions as the number of missing pieces increases.
